name: CommentThread
description:
Comments and one level of replies with a RichTextInput composer. Bodies are Markdown, and
mentions are the composer's. The thread holds no policy: `permissions` says what exists, a
string keeps a control disabled with that reason, and the host saves through its callbacks.

A send shows at once, as pending, in the place it will keep; a failure stays there with Retry
and Discard. New comments from others wait behind a count, so the composer does not move
(R17.3). A resolved thread folds behind a button and has no composer. Times tick outside live
regions; outcomes are announced politely.
signature: ({ comments, defaultComments, onCommentsChange, currentUser, permissions, onSubmit, onEdit, onDelete, onReactionsChange, resolved, defaultResolved, onResolvedChange, anchor, anchorHref, onAnchorClick, mentions, renderBody, fill, loading, error, onRetry, holdNew, className, "aria-label": label, }: CommentThreadProps): import("react").JSX.Element

props.name: anchor
props.description: What the thread is about: "Floor plan, page 3". It also names the thread.

props.name: anchorHref
props.description: Makes `anchor` a link.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Names the thread. Default "Comments", or the anchor.

props.name: className
props.description: Layout classes.

props.name: comments
props.description: The comments, controlled, oldest first.

props.name: currentUser
props.description: The signed-in person: the pending comment's author, and whose comments show at once. Needed to comment.

props.name: defaultComments
props.description: The comments at first when uncontrolled. The thread then applies sends, edits and deletes itself.

props.name: defaultResolved
props.description: Whether the thread starts resolved when uncontrolled.

props.name: error
props.description: Why the thread failed, shown in the list's place. Pass `true` for a factual line.

props.name: fill
props.description: The comments scroll inside the thread and the composer stays at its foot. Give the parent a height. Default false: the thread takes the height it needs.

props.name: holdNew
props.description: New comments wait behind a count until asked for, so the composer does not move (R17.3); the person's own show at once. `false` shows every one at once. Default true.

props.name: loading
props.description: First load: skeleton comments in the list's place.

props.name: mentions
props.description: The mention list for the composers.

props.name: onAnchorClick
props.description: Makes `anchor` a button.

props.name: onCommentsChange
props.description: Called with the next comments after a change the thread made itself.

props.name: onDelete
props.description: Deletes a comment. A throw keeps the confirmation open and shows a toast.

props.name: onEdit
props.type: ((comment: CommentEntry, body: string) => Promise<void> | void) | undefined
props.description: Saves an edit. A throw keeps the editor open with the text.

props.name: onReactionsChange
props.type: ((comment: CommentEntry, reactions: readonly Reaction[]) => void) | undefined
props.description: Called when a person adds or removes a reaction, with the comment's next reactions.

props.name: onResolvedChange
props.description: Called with the next resolved state.

props.name: onRetry
props.description: Offers Retry after `error`, and calls it.

props.name: onSubmit
props.type: ((draft: CommentDraft) => Promise<CommentEntry | void> | CommentEntry | void) | undefined
props.description: Saves a comment or reply. Resolve to finish; a throw marks it failed, with Retry. Uncontrolled, resolve with the saved comment to keep its id.

props.name: permissions
props.description: What the person may do. Absent, the thread is read-only.

props.name: renderBody
props.description: Draws a comment's text. Default: Markdown, loaded on demand.

props.name: resolved
props.description: Whether the thread is resolved, controlled.
